The Invasion of Seram codenamed “Operation Fajar” (Indonesian: Operasi Fajar) was the second military counterinsurgent campaign conducted by Indonesian National Armed Forces to supressed the Republic of South Maluku rebellion movement after the Invasion of Buru (1950). The objective of this invasion was secured and restored the Indonesian control over Seram Island. The Invasion ended by the Indonesian victories and the expulsion of Republic of South Maluku from Seram Island.
